citations.quote: The major efficacy outcome measure was overall response rate (ORR) according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST v1.1) as evaluated by blinded independent central review (BICR). Additional efficacy outcome measures included duration of response (DOR) by BICR. Efficacy results are summarized in Table 5.

The primary efficacy population for this review comprises 114 patients with locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations treated with mobocertinib 160 mg orally once daily (QD) in the multi-cohort Study 101.

result.text: ORR 28% (95% CI 20, 37) by BICR; median DOR 17.5 months (95% CI 7.4, 20.3); 59% of responders had DOR ≥6 months.

target_moa.text: Mobocertinib is an oral, irreversible kinase (EGFR TKI) inhibitor designed to selectively inhibit EGFR with exon 20 insertion mutations over wild-type EGFR; it inhibited all 14 mutant EGFR variants in cellular assays (IC50 2.4–22 nM) at lower concentrations than WT EGFR (IC50 35 nM).

citations.quote: Mobocertinib (formerly TAK-788 and AP32788), an oral, first-in-class, irreversible TKI, was uniquely designed to address the limitations of existing therapies targeting EGFR and HER2.
In cellular assays, mobocertinib inhibited the in vitro activity of all 14 mutant variants of EGFR (IC_{50} = 2.4–22 nM) at lower concentrations than WT EGFR (IC_{50} = 35 nM).
Mobocertinib is a kinase inhibitor.

key_safety.text: Most common (>20%) adverse reactions: diarrhea, rash, nausea, stomatitis, vomiting, decreased appetite, paronychia, fatigue, dry skin, and musculoskeletal pain. In the N=114 population, diarrhea occurred in 92% (22% Grade 3/4) and rash in 78%. Most serious risks: QTc prolongation/Torsades de Pointes, ILD/pneumonitis, cardiac toxicity, and diarrhea.

detail.text: QTc prolongation and Torsades de Pointes: EXKIVITY can cause life-threatening heart rate-corrected QT (QTc) prolongation, including Torsades de Pointes, which can be fatal, requiring monitoring of QTc and electrolytes at baseline and periodically.
